text: Compared to a literature correlation, our orifice coefficients are 3 to 5 percent lower at pipe Reynolds numbers in the transition region below 10,000. For turbulent-flow Reynolds numbers, our coefficients are 2 to 5 percent higher than the literature correlation. Thus, our values are not within the 1 to 2 percent deviation range claimed by ASME (1971) for a well-designed orifice meter. The discrepancies were explained by experimental uncertainties, based on our best judgment of the uncertainty for each of our measurements.
